messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline 25 mg tablets
Sertraline 50 mg tablets
Sertraline 100 mg tablets
Sertraline oral solution, 20 mg per mL
Sertraline 150 mg capsules
Sertraline 200 mg capsules
Capsule strengths are based on sertraline itself.
A 150 mg capsule contains 168 mg of sertraline hydrochloride.
A 200 mg capsule contains 224 mg.
Capsule appearance and imprints differ between manufacturers.
Triplet: ["capsule", "has varying", "appearance and imprints"]

The relation 'has varying' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity exhibits differences or variations in the characteristic specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'vary by': The subject entity differs depending on the object entity.
B. 'can be': The subject condition or entity may be characterized by the object condition or entity.
C. 'is different from': The subject condition or effect is distinct or different from the object condition or effect.
D. 'may appear in': A part of the subject entity may be present or appear in the entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or symptom can resemble or be mistaken for the medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
